# JM Estate — default build/delivery instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` and `coding-estate/LIVE_DIRECT_DOOR_LAW.md` before changing or delivering estate-hosted HTML/web bodies.

Default delivery law: **SOURCE → OPEN_FIRST → ESTATE MOUNT → LIVE PROOF → DIRECT DOOR**.

For HTML/web descendants, present the proved live estate URL first. Sandbox/download/ZIP routes are fallback or archival only unless the owner explicitly requests them. Preserve source lineage, responsive fit, proof boundaries, and no-Ding/no-claim discipline.
